# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）三大业务分部完整分析报告

## 一、公司整体业绩速览

| 指标 | 本季（GAAP） | 上年同期 | 同比 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $90,007M | $76,441M | +18%（恒定汇率 +17%） |
| 经营利润 | $40,603M | $34,323M | +18% |
| 净利润（GAAP） | $35,766M | $27,233M | +31% |
| 净利润（Non-GAAP） | $35,286M | $28,808M | +22% |
| 摊薄 EPS（GAAP） | $4.81 | $3.65 | +32% |
| 摊薄 EPS（Non-GAAP） | $4.74 | $3.86 | +23% |

> 出处：press_release.txt 第 0 行（"Revenue was $90.0 billion and increased 18%"）；financial_statements.txt "Income Statements" 工作表第 3/5 行（Total revenue 90007/76441）；metrics.txt 第 0 行。

本季还有一些一次性项目影响 EPS：$3.2B 的 Anthropic 投资收益、Voluntary Retirement Program 费用低于预期，部分被 XBOX 减值和遣散费抵消，合计带来 $0.27 的 EPS 增量（press_release.txt 第 0 段）。

---

## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力与商业流程）

### 2.1 关键财务数据（本季）

| 指标 | 本季金额（M） | 上年同期（M） | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $37,847 | $33,112 | +14.3%（GAAP）/ +14%（恒定汇率） |
| 营业成本 | $6,989 | $6,042 | +15.7% |
| 经营费用 | $8,958 | $8,077 | +10.9% |
| 经营利润 | $21,900 | $18,993 | +15.3% |
| 经营利润率 | 57.9% | 57.4% | +0.5 pp |

> 出处：financial_statements.txt "Segment Results" 工作表——Productivity and Business Practices 各行（Revenue 37847/33112, Cost of revenue 6989/6042, Operating expenses 8958/8077, Operating income 21900/18993）；press_release.txt 第 0 段（"Revenue in Productivity and Business Processes was $37.8 billion and increased 14%"）；metrics.txt 第 0 行。

### 2.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Microsoft 365 Commercial 云**：Amy Hood 在电话会指出："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. On a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）。增长由 Copilot 势头推动——"net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million"，且 Premium 产品组合（Copilot、E5、E7）推动了 ARPU 增长（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）。

2. **M365 Commercial products**："M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）

3. **M365 Consumer cloud**："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）

4. **LinkedIn**："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）

5. **Dynamics 365**："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."（transcript.txt 第 22960 行）

6. **分部毛利率**："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains."（transcript.txt 第 24746 行）

7. **经营费用**："Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier."（transcript.txt 第 24746 行）

8. **经营利润与利润率**："Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."（transcript.txt 第 24746 行）

---

## 三、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 3.1 关键财务数据（本季）

| 指标 | 本季金额（M） | 上年同期（M） | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $39,306 | $29,878 | +31.6%（GAAP）/ +31%（恒定汇率） |
| 营业成本 | $16,876 | $11,845 | +42.5% |
| 经营费用 | $6,475 | $5,893 | +9.9% |
| 经营利润 | $15,955 | $12,140 | +31.4% |
| 经营利润率 | 40.6% | 40.6% | 持平 |

> 出处：financial_statements.txt "Segment Results" 工作表——Intelligent Cloud 各行（Revenue 39306/29878, Cost of revenue 16876/11845, Operating expenses 6475/5893, Operating income 15955/12140）；press_release.txt 第 0 段（"Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32%"）；metrics.txt 第 0 行。

### 3.2 增长驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Azure 和其他云服务**（分部最大增长引擎）：Amy Hood 在电话会指出："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."（transcript.txt 第 24808 行及第 25283 行）

2. **GitHub Copilot**："Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."（transcript.txt 第 25283 行）

3. **本地服务器业务**："In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."（transcript.txt 第 25283 行）

4. **分部毛利率**："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."（transcript.txt 第 25283 行）

5. **经营费用**："Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."（transcript.txt 第 26299 行）

6. **经营利润与利润率**："Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."（transcript.txt 第 26299 行，注意原文口径为约 41%，与 financial_statements.txt 中 40.6% 略差异源于四舍五入；按报表精确数字为 40.6%）

---

## 四、分部三：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

### 4.1 关键财务数据（本季）

| 指标 | 本季金额（M） | 上年同期（M） | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 营业收入 | $12,854 | $13,451 | -4.4%（GAAP）/ -5%（恒定汇率） |
| 营业成本 | $5,660 | $6,127 | -7.6% |
| 经营费用 | $4,446 | $4,134 | +7.5% |
| 经营利润 | $2,748 | $3,190 | -13.9% |
| 经营利润率 | 21.4% | 23.7% | -2.3 pp |

> 出处：financial_statements.txt "Segment Results" 工作表——More Personal Computing 各行（Revenue 12854/13451, Cost of revenue 5660/6127, Operating expenses 4446/4134, Operating income 2748/3190）；press_release.txt 第 0 段（"Revenue in More Personal Computing was $12.9 billion and decreased 4%"）；metrics.txt 第 0 行。

### 4.2 下滑驱动因素（引用原文）

1. **Windows OEM and Devices**："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."（transcript.txt 第 26435 行及第 26531 行）

2. **搜索广告**："Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."（transcript.txt 第 26531 行）

3. **XBOX**："In XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."（transcript.txt 第 27080 行）

4. **分部毛利率**："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition."（transcript.txt 第 27080 行）

5. **经营费用**："Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX."（transcript.txt 第 27138 行及第 27592 行）

6. **经营利润与利润率**："Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."（transcript.txt 第 27592 行）

7. **XBOX 减值**：press_release.txt 第 0 段明确提到本季存在 "impairment charges in XBOX"（约 3.2B Anthropic 收益被部分抵消的项目之一）。在电话会中，Amy Hood 也提到："We have the best IP in the industry...and believe we can bring these strengths together and expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027."（transcript.txt 第 17147 行），表明 Xbox 处于战略重组阶段。

---

## 五、全公司合计数与分部勾稽验证

| 指标 | 分部 A (P&BP) | 分部 B (IC) | 分部 C (MPC) | 合计 | 报表数 | 勾稽 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 37,847 | 39,306 | 12,854 | **90,007** | 90,007 | ✓ |
| 营业成本 | 6,989 | 16,876 | 5,660 | **29,525** | 29,525 | ✓ |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 | 6,475 | 4,446 | **19,879** | 19,879 | ✓ |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 | 15,955 | 2,748 | **40,603** | 40,603 | ✓ |
| 经营利润率 | 57.9% | 40.6% | 21.4% | 45.1% | 45.1% | ✓ |
| YoY 收入增速 | +14.3% | +31.6% | -4.4% | +17.7% | +18% | — |

> 出处：全部数字来自 financial_statements.txt "Segment Results" 工作表，与 press_release.txt、metrics.txt 完全一致。勾稽关系全部 PASS。

**说明**：分部 YoY 增速是各自分部的同比增速，而全公司合计的 +18% 是总公司和按总和分别计算的一致结果（17.7% 四舍五入到 press_release 中的 18%）。

## 七、口径提示与使用注意事项

1. **分部收入之和等于全公司收入**：三个分部收入加总（90,007）等于全公司报告收入，但经营利润之和也等于全公司（40,603），说明公司未在分部之上设置额外的公司层面成本/收入项目（或其净影响为零）。读者在引用时无需额外调整。

2. **成本与费用的归属**：每个分部的"Cost of revenue"和"Operating expenses"按公司内部分配规则归入各分部，跨分部比较时需注意——例如 IC 的成本（16,876M）远高于 P&BP（6,989M），主要因为 Azure/IaaS 属于基础设施密集型业务，而 P&BP 主要是 SaaS 模式，成本结构天然不同。**不可直接用成本绝对值比较业务"效率"**。

3. **经营利润率差异巨大**：P&BP 57.9% vs IC 40.6% vs MPC 21.4%，这种差异反映了业务模式根本不同（SaaS vs 基础设施 vs 设备/广告），跨分部对比利润率时务必理解其业务构成差异。

4. **YoY 增速口径**：
   - press_release 中报告的 14%、32%、-4% 为 GAAP 口径；
   - 恒定汇率调整较小（P&BP +14% → +14%，IC +32% → +31%，MPC -4% → -5%），因为本季 FX 影响整体不到 1 个百分点；
   - 全公司收入增速 press_release 中披露为 18%（GAAP），metrics.txt 中披露为 18%/17%（GAAP/CC），分部增速加总不等于全公司增速（因分部基数不同）。

5. **Non-GAAP 调整**：全公司层面有 OpenAI 投资影响的 Non-GAAP 调整（本季净收益影响 -$480M，EPS 影响 -$0.07），但**分部财务数据本身未做 OpenAI 调整**。投资者在分析分部利润率时应使用 GAAP 分部数据，或自行按比例分摊 OpenAI 影响（公司未公开分部级的 OpenAI 影响）。

6. **一次性项目**：本季 EPS 受 $3.2B Anthropic 投资收益、Voluntary Retirement Program 节省、XBOX 减值和遣散费等影响（合计 +$0.27 EPS）。这些项目主要体现在公司层面和全公司毛利/费用中，**分部报表中仅 XBOX 的减值在 MPC 经营费用中体现**（transcript 第 27592 行提到"impairment charges in XBOX"计入 MPC 费用）。

7. **Microsoft Cloud 是跨分部指标**：$59.3B 的 Microsoft Cloud 收入跨越 P&BP（M365 Commercial/Consumer）和 IC（Azure）两个分部，不能简单归属某一分部。Azure 单独披露为 43% 增长（IC 内部），但 M365 Commercial cloud 的 14%/16%（调整）属 P&BP。

8. **历史数据可比性**：financial_statements.txt 中"Segment Results"工作表同时包含 FY25 Q4 与 FY26 Q4 数据，可做季度趋势分析，但 FY25 全年数据（fiscal year ended June 30, 2025）需用 10-K 中的全年数据校验，季度数据可能与全年推算存在舍入差异。

9. **Metrics 中的"%" 为双口径**：metrics.txt 中所有增长率均标注为 "GAAP% / Constant Currency%"，如 Azure 43%/43%、Windows OEM -7%/-7%。读者引用时需明确使用的是哪一个口径。

10. **分部毛利率（gross margin percentage）未在标准分部报表中直接披露**：metrics.txt 中披露 Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage = 65%，但这是跨分部合并口径。分部级 gross margin 仅在 transcript 中以"Segment gross margin dollars increased/decreased X%"形式出现（绝对额未公开），且与"Cost of revenue"口径不完全等同（含分配调整）。

---

**报告结论**：微软 FY26 Q4 全公司收入 $90B 同比增长 18%，经营利润 $40.6B 同步增长 18%，三大分部中 Intelligent Cloud 以 +32% 增速继续引领增长（Azure +43%），Productivity and Business Processes 稳健增长 +14%（M365 Copilot 推动），而 More Personal Computing 受 PC 市场需求疲弱和 Xbox 内容周期影响下滑 4%，是唯一录得负增长的分部。所有分部财务数据均通过勾稽验证，可直接用于财务建模与进一步分析。
